RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Seattle operates under a mayor-council government. The Mayor is Bruce Harrell. The City Council has nine members; seven are elected by district, and two are elected at-large. Sara Nelson is the Council President. There was a discrepancy between some seattle.gov listings and a January 2024 news article regarding Council Members for Districts 2 and 5. The news article, which detailed the swearing-in of new members in January 2024, was prioritized for these specific district roles as it represents a more recent event of official changes.

Rob Saka.name: Rob Saka
divisions: District 1 (West Seattle, South Park, Georgetown, and Pioneer Square)

Mark Solomon.name: Mark Solomon
divisions: District 2 (South Seattle, Yesler Terrace to Rainier Beach)

Bob Kettle.name: Bob Kettle
divisions: District 7 (Downtown to Magnolia, including Queen Anne, Uptown, Westlake, Interbay, Eastlake, South Lake Union, and Belltown)
